investigations.summary: PSMDB Shard 7.x CLI (latest-tarball and 3.10.0 client): PMM-T2445 (mongoDb-psmdb-mongolog-change-agent.spec.ts) failed in both jobs: with the latest client the exporter showed Running but mongodb_up stayed 0 until the 120 s test timeout, and with 3.10.0 it stayed Starting for 90 s. Both happened after the test changed the agent with --skip-connection-check and then reset its credentials. This is the open PMM-15835 lost update (a ChangeAgent racing the agent's status report), which already lists PMM-T2435, PMM-T2446 and PMM-T2445. Deduped, not re-reproduced.
